confirmedControlOutcomes: The 17-node, 44-edge dependency graph is acyclic and every dependency points to an earlier stage.
Platform, workload, deployment, role-assignment and Internal Audit authority remain separated and least-privileged.
Deployment uses interactive sign-in or an explicitly authorised managed identity; GitHub OIDC, stored credentials, secret parameters and cached credentials as release artefacts are prohibited.
SQL, Storage, App Configuration, Search, AI and other supported private resources disable public access from creation; APIM exposes no route before private approval, DNS/path proof and lockdown.
Private endpoint group IDs, DNS zones, links and resolver or forwarder paths are explicit rather than inferred.
Exact AVM candidates require interface, changelog, source, rendered-template and digest review; Foundry Citadel remains blocked pending an immutable reviewed revision.
Phase 5 requires pinned tools, deterministic builds, content hashes, SBOM, image signature, vulnerability and licence evidence with no unaccepted finding.
External data remains quarantined until permission, licence, purpose, privacy and admission evidence passes; source write-back and foundation-model training are prohibited.
AI remains regional, private, assistive and draft-only with retained human and specialist authority.
SQL Local or Zone backup policy, explicit failover groups, PITR, rebuild or replay procedures, hash-chain verification and immutable Internal Audit evidence are retained.
Destructive rollback, failover or failback, restoration, role revocation, immutability changes and Key Vault purge require explicit scoped authorisation.
All approved traceability and seven residual controls are mapped without waiver.
